# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE_VWAP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger

## Hypothesis

Bearish RSI divergence at VWAP resistance signals a short opportunity. When price makes a higher high while RSI makes a lower high, and the price is above VWAP, it indicates weakening momentum despite the price rise, suggesting a potential reversal to the downside. This edge exists because the RSI divergence warns of exhaustion in the uptrend, and the VWAP resistance acts as a dynamic support/resistance level that, when combined, increases the probability of a short-term reversal.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When price makes a higher high (compared to the previous high) while RSI makes a lower high (compared to the previous RSI high), and the price is above the VWAP, enter short at the close of the divergence bar. Exit shape: Stop placed above the recent swing high (the high of the divergence bar or the prior swing high, whichever is higher) for structure invalidation; target is 1R (equal to the risk) or trail using a premium-stop % exit (e.g., trail 20% of the premium from the high-water mark). Regime hint: Effective in ranging or mild uptrend (ADX <20) with VIX >12; avoid strong trending days (ADX >30).
